body:
## Summary
- Implements animated tutorial hint system for issue #944
- New hints fade in smoothly (0.3s) when appearing
- Completed actions show strikethrough animation followed by fade-out
- Multi-step actions (reload, grenade, bolt cycle) cross out completed steps progressively
- Multi-step actions don't re-strikethrough the whole line when complete - just fade out

## Changes
- Added animation timing constants for fade-in, strikethrough display, and fade-out
- Modified `_add_hint()` to start transparent and animate to full opacity
- Modified `_dismiss_hint()` to show strikethrough before fading out
- Updated all BBCode builder functions to use `[s]` tag for completed steps
- Added tracking for animations in progress and multi-step completion status

## Test plan
- [ ] Play tutorial level with M16 - verify fire mode hint fades in, then gets struck through and fades out when B is pressed
- [ ] Play tutorial level with sniper - verify bolt cycle hint crosses out each step [←][↓][↑][→] progressively
- [ ] Play tutorial level - verify reload hints cross out completed steps (R→F→R sequence)
- [ ] Play tutorial level - verify grenade hint crosses out steps as player progresses through throw sequence
- [ ] Verify multi-step hints just fade out at completion (no double strikethrough)
- [ ] Verify new hints appearing have smooth fade-in animation

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#944

Issue: https://github.com/Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP/issues/944

Implements the tutorial hint animation system as requested:

1. **Fade-in animation for new hints**: New tutorial strings appear with
   a smooth fade-in effect (0.3s) instead of appearing instantly.

2. **Strikethrough animation for completed actions**: When a tutorial action
   is completed, the hint text is crossed out with a thick strikethrough
   line, then fades out (0.4s strikethrough display + 0.3s fade-out).

3. **Per-step strikethrough for multi-step actions**: In multi-step actions
   (reload sequences, grenade throwing, bolt cycling), only the completed
   steps are crossed out as progress is made. The whole line is NOT struck
   through a second time at completion - it just fades away.

Technical changes:
- Added animation constants: HINT_FADE_IN_DURATION, HINT_STRIKETHROUGH_DURATION,
  HINT_FADE_OUT_DURATION
- Added tracking dictionaries: _animating_hints (prevent double-dismiss),
  _hint_is_multistep_completed (track per-step strikethrough usage)
- Modified _add_hint() to start transparent and fade in
- Modified _dismiss_hint() to animate strikethrough before fade-out
- Updated all _build_*_hint_bbcode() functions to use [s] BBCode tag for
  completed steps instead of just grey color

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#944
